Visited a small town to run a bachelor party for a friend. My running schedule now includes runs on the weekend. So there I am running in a park that is kind of small but the best the town has to offer. It's big enough to be an off-leash park.

BEGIN skippable dog-related preface

If I can just wax /v/running for a minute, off-leash parks are fine where I live, because most dogs are well socialized. They'll run behind or alongside a runner for a little bit sometimes, and get excited and try to jump sometimes, but the motivation is clearly excitement and happiness. They're not attacking, they're not interfering most of the time, they're okay. Most people are mild fuckheads because they never train their dogs to heel, and their response to their dogs running at someone is to shout their name. The dogs never go "oh my owner wants me to come back," they sometimes act as if the shouting is encouragement. Dogs are fine, people are fucktarded. Fortunately, my area has a lot of wide open space and dogs are exercised and nice enough that they don't need training to not attack people.

So there I am running around in this park. It's maybe 2km long so I'm doing laps along the walking path. I pass a father and son with a black lab and a beagle. They sniff as I go by, and follow for a few seconds, no problem. I pass a lady with a bigger fluffy black dog, she holds the leash, no problem. I pass a fit dude with another big black dog who kneels down and holds the dog as I go by, no problem. Lots of big black dogs, which is kind of odd, but whatever, they're all pleasant. A lady is walking a dachsund that chases me for a couple of steps but it's friendly and can't keep up. The point I want to emphasize is that it's easy and common to have dogs that can handle being in an off-leash park.

END skippable dog-related preface

Nearing the end of my run I see a female dump truck kin on the path ahead of me. She's wearing black spandex and sandals, she's got that barrel shape and the knock-kneed look from having so much fat on the upper legs. You know the type, drinking 800-cal Starbeetus frappes during their 200-cal weekly waddle. Beside her on the left is a fairly swole dude. I presume he's either her brother or a desperately broken boyfriend. Beside her on the right is a little rat dog. You know the type, 6 inches high and fluffy, huge eyes, constantly shaking or pissing itself. More pomeranian than chihuahua, but it lacks the cheerful look a pomeranian has. It just looks scared. It looks scared, I think, because its dump truck owner never goes outside and demands the dog never leave her side, so this is a terrifying and new environment for the dog.

You know what dogs do when they're scared? They get defensive. They get aggressive. This dog, it scampers off to the side as I pass. Okay. No problem.

Then I see the three other rat dogs this fat bitch is herding around the park. They see me coming. All of them have more rage in the tremble/rage composition of all rat dogs. All three of them lose their fucking shit. Bark, bark, barkbarkbarkbarkbarkbarkbarkbark, little fucking yippy dogs I just want to stomp on. I try to ignore them. They're terrified in a new environment, they are clearly not socialized because their dump truck owner never lets her babies out of the house. All I want is to get past this moment of human failure and the suffering of dogs that results, and finish my run.

Then one of the little fuckers chases me and tries to bite me. I don't even notice it happening- I don't have headphones on but I am focusing really hard on my breathing to maintain a specific level of effort. Suddenly the yipping cuts off and I feel a tug on the bottom of my shoe. The little fucker went for my ankle and got a heel in the face for its trouble. What does the dump truck do? Just like every other dumbshit owner on the planet, she screeches incoherently at the dog.

That's it. That's all that happens. That's the FPS. I finish my run, I go home. But every other dog in that park was socialized, trained or restrained, and gave me no trouble at all.

But It's only the fat bitches with the unsocialized, uncontrolled, yippy dogs. It's only the fat bitches with the dogs that go apeshit and chase everyone they see. It's only the fat bitches whose desperate need for affection, unmet by human contacts, make them purchase baby-sized dogs, who abuse their dogs by keeping them locked up in their stys, who produce horrid little stomp targets because those dogs exist only to serve their fat bitch owners need for affection for her, and fuck the dogs themselves and the rest of the human race that has to deal with them.

Fuck fat bitches with their yippy little rat dogs.

Urgh, I hate people who don't train their dogs properly. Irresponsible dog owners give good ones a bad name, because they often get lumped in the same group. If a dog is biting random people in a park, it needs to be retrained or kept out of the public.
